experiments.scope: The algorithm of proof.md Section 3 (Floyd cycle detection then tail location, same caps scaled to N = 2^16) on the 16-bit truncation g(x) = digest bits 0..15 of complete six-round SHA3-256 of the 32-byte encoding of x, from the trial seed's low 16 bits. Each trial returns the two distinct 32-byte messages at the rho junction.
experiments.hypothesis: If f behaves as a random mapping, every trial returns a pair of distinct messages whose full digests agree on bits 0..15, except when the start lies on its own cycle (probability about 0.5%), and the observation 'evaluations' averages about 800. Organizer-checked event: (digest(a) XOR digest(b)) AND mask(bits 0..15) == 0. Nothing about 256-bit cost is measured.
